name: After recital E
title: REPORT on the amendment of the European Electoral act, allowing Members to vote in plenary by proxy voting during pregnancy and after giving birth
section: Recital E a (new) | Recital E a (new) | Recital E a (new)
part_text: E a. whereas in its resolution of 4 April 2022 on the Reform of the electoral law of the EU, Parliament already proposed the possibility for a temporary replacement of a Member in the case of maternity, paternity or parental leave or in the case of leave due to a severe illness. / E a. whereas in its resolution of 4 April 2022 on the Reform of the electoral law of the EU, the European Parliament already proposed the possibility for a temporary replacement of a Member in the case of maternity, paternity or parental leave or in the case of leave due to a severe illness. / E a. whereas in its resolution of 4 April 2022 on the Reform of the electoral law of the EU, the European Parliament already proposed the possibility for a temporary replacement of a Member in the case of maternity, paternity or parental leave or in the case of leave due to a severe illness.
